headline: US Confirms Limited Scale Strike on Iran Amid Oil Price Rise
summary: US President Donald Trump confirmed a lower-scale US military strike targeting an Iranian anti-aircraft installation, occurring amid diplomatic negotiations with Tehran and rising oil prices.
why: Geopolitical conflicts in the Middle East involving major oil producers directly impact global crude oil supplies and energy market volatility.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Military strikes in the Middle East heighten supply disruption risks, pushing oil prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Military action involving Iran raised concerns over Middle East energy supplies, driving up crude oil prices.
